IDT12420.text:
Thursday 19 November
Winds: South to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 20 November
Winds: North to northeasterly about 10 knots tending east to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then becoming north to northeasterly below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers.

Saturday 21 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming southerly 10 to 15 knots during the day then becoming variable below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 60% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the afternoon.

Sunday 22 November
Winds: North to northwesterly about 10 knots tending north to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots during the day then tending north to northwesterly 10 to 15 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A high pressure system sits over Tasmania. The high will move slowly eastwards and into the Tasman Sea on Thursday. A low pressure system and associated trough approach from the west on Thursday and is forecast to move over the state on Friday. A cold front will then approach Tasmania from the west on Sunday, crossing the state overnight.
